title: 第七章    苏本的想法
content_zh:
苏本看着女儿这么认真的神情，有些叹息，女儿已经不知道多少次买回来这些江湖骗子的药了，他决定这次结束后，要好好跟女儿交流一番，另外自己的那位好朋友给自己介绍来的那个人，想想应该也快到自己的公司来了。

    苏本知道自己的女儿因为长得漂亮，在学校经常受到骚扰，苏本答应那位朋友的要求，一来是相信那位朋友的眼光，第二也希望能给自己的女儿找个伴读或者保镖，女儿一个人太孤单了。

    当然如果介绍的那个人不能通过他的考验，苏本也不会轻易让陌生人接近自己的女儿。苏本就这样站在自己女儿的身后，看着她。

    苏林依拿出一杯凉水，将药丸放到自己母亲的嘴边，就在苏林依准备用凉水将药丸灌下去的时候，药丸竟然化成了一道白光，直接流进了母亲的口中，苏林依直接呆住了，这还是她第一次看到这种情况，这种事情也太过神奇了吧。

    她本来以为母亲吃过药丸之后，仍然醒不过来，最后自己还是以失望而告终。不过转而一想，不会是什么化学反应吧！苏林依虽然求了很多神药，但她毕竟是大学生，自然没有真的那么迷信，也知道这些骗子的药绝不可能吃死人，最多弄些糖丸或者巧克力丸之类的糊弄人。

    苏林依吓了一跳，脸色一下变白了，不过在一想，似乎这个药丸直接碰到了母亲的嘴边便化成了流光，难道这个药丸是真的不成，想到这里，苏林依便开始激动了起来。期待着看着床上的母亲。

    过了一会，躺在病床上原本一动不动的女子，竟然微微颤抖了一下自己的双眼，然后睁开了，苏林依见到母亲醒来，一把抱住了母亲，哭道：“妈，你醒来了，太好了，我以为我再也看不到你了。。。”

    苏林依怕自己是在做梦，掐了自己一下，感到一股疼痛

    “疼。。这不是做梦，妈，你真的好了！”

    看着女儿激动的表情，苏林依的母亲柳晴也是彻底清醒了过来，她想到了自己最后因为心脏突然疼痛难忍，便晕了过去，之后的事她便不知道了

    “依依，让你担心了，是妈不好。。。”柳晴看着苏林依温柔道

    苏本原本有些暗淡的眼神，在此刻立刻放出无限的光彩！难道这个世上真的有一些自己不知道的神奇事物存在？不然为什么专家已经说不能救了，女儿的一粒来历不明的丹药却能救活？苏本神情变得有些恍惚了起来。

    。。。。
content_en:
Seeing his daughter's serious expression, Su Ben sighed a little. His daughter had bought medicines from these charlatans countless times. He decided that after this time, he would have a good communication with his daughter. In addition, the person introduced to him by his good friend should be coming to his company soon.

Su Ben knew that his daughter was often harassed at school because of her beauty. Su Ben agreed to the friend's request. Firstly, he believed in the friend's vision. Secondly, he also hoped to find a companion or bodyguard for his daughter. Her daughter was too lonely alone.

Of course, if the person introduced could not pass his test, Su Ben would not easily let a stranger approach his daughter.Su Ben stood behind his daughter and looked at her.

Su Linyi took out a glass of cold water and put the pills to her mother's mouth. Just when Su Linyi was about to drink the pills with the cold water, the pills turned into a white light and flowed directly into her mother's mouth. Su Linyi was stunned. This was the first time she had seen such a situation. This kind of thing must be too magical.

She originally thought that her mother still couldn't wake up after taking the pills, but she ended up disappointed.But when I think about it, it can’t be a chemical reaction!Although Su Linyi asked for many magical medicines, she was a college student after all, so she was not really superstitious. She also knew that these scammers' medicines would never kill people, and they would at most be deceptive like sugar pills or chocolate pills.

Su Linyi was startled, and her face suddenly turned pale, but when she thought about it, it seemed that the pill turned into liquid when it directly touched her mother's mouth. Could it be that this pill was really bad? Thinking of this, Su Linyi began to get excited.Looking forward to my mother on the bed.

After a while, the motionless woman lying on the hospital bed actually trembled slightly, and then opened her eyes. Su Linyi saw her mother waking up, hugged her, and cried: "Mom, you woke up, it's great, I thought I would never see you again..."

Su Linyi was afraid that she was dreaming, so she pinched herself and felt a pain.

"It hurts... This is not a dream, Mom, you are really healed!"

Seeing her daughter's excited expression, Su Linyi's mother Liu Qing also came to her senses completely. She thought about the sudden unbearable pain in her heart and fainted. She didn't know what happened after that.

"Yiyi, it's mom's fault for making you worry..." Liu Qing looked at Su Linyi and said softly

Su Ben's eyes, which were originally somewhat dim, immediately glowed with infinite brilliance at this moment!Are there really some magical things in this world that I don’t know about?Otherwise, why could an elixir of unknown origin save my daughter's life even though experts said she couldn't be saved?Su Ben's expression became a little dazed.
